description: Search apps, browse categories, enumerate the whole Marketplace, fetch apps by ID or URL, list a developer's apps, or export reviews.

appIds.description: Numeric Marketplace app IDs or full app URLs. Required for byAppId and reviews modes.
appIds.title: App IDs or URLs (mode=byAppId / reviews)

category.description: Category or subcategory to browse. Required in byCategory mode.
category.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

developerName.description: Publisher/developer name to look up, e.g. `Lucid Software`. Required in byDeveloper mode.
developerName.title: Developer name (mode=byDeveloper)

includeDetails.description: Fetch each app's detail page to add OAuth permissions, exact Works-with icons and the text-review total. Adds one request per emitted app.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Optional enrichment. Both options add extra requests per app; leave them off for the fastest, cheapest runs.
includeDetails.title: Include permissions and detail enrichment

includeReviews.description: Attach reviews to each app record. The rating and date filters below also apply. Ignored by reviews mode, which always emits review rows.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews on each app

language.description: Language for listing text and review content.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Maximum records to emit. Search and category pages hold at most 100 apps each; browseAll can reach about 1,500 apps. In reviews mode this caps review rows.
maxItems.sectionDescription: How much data to return and which language the listing pages are read in.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxReviewRating.description: Drop reviews rated above this value (0-5). 0 = no maximum. Applies to reviews mode and includeReviews.
maxReviewRating.title: Maximum review rating

maxReviewsPerApp.description: How many matching reviews to attach in includeReviews, or how many to export per app in reviews mode.
maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app

minInstalls.description: Drop apps installed fewer times than this (exact count). 0 = no minimum.
minInstalls.title: Minimum installs

minRating.description: Drop apps rated below this value (0–5). 0 = no minimum.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewRating.description: Drop reviews rated below this value (0-5). 0 = no minimum. Applies to reviews mode and includeReviews; filtering happens client-side over fetched review pages.
minReviewRating.title: Minimum review rating

minReviews.description: Drop apps with fewer ratings than this. 0 = no minimum.
minReviews.title: Minimum ratings count

mode.description: What to fetch. search=keyword search; byCategory=one category; browseAll=every category (deduplicated); byAppId=exact apps; byDeveloper=apps by publisher name (keyword search plus all category pages); reviews=review rows with optional rating/date filters.
enumTitles: Fetch specific apps by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

pricing.description: Marketplace price facet: free = the app has a free option; paid = the app has a paid option. Applied to every app mode, including byAppId. Use the next field for an exact price class.
pricing.title: Price option

pricingModel.description: Keep only apps with this exact published price class. Apps with no published price are omitted when a class is selected.
pricingModel.title: Exact price class

reviewsSince.description: Drop reviews published before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no date limit. Applies to reviews mode and includeReviews.
reviewsSince.title: Reviews since

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for. Required in search mode. The Marketplace returns at most 100 apps per query.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

worksWith.description: Keep only apps that integrate with this Google product. Applied to every app mode: search, byCategory, browseAll, byDeveloper and byAppId.
worksWith.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied to every app mode, including byAppId records.
worksWith.title: Works with

title: Google Workspace Marketplace Scraper Input
